title: Calendar Event Payload
description: Payload for a single academic calendar event. Retrieved by deterministic tool call, never by semantic search.

session.description: REQUIRED. The single most important disambiguator -- three concurrent sessions have different deadlines for the same action.

weekday_as_published.description: Weekday exactly as printed in the source. Cross-checked against the real date by the validation gate to catch transcription errors.

time.description: e.g. '08:00' or '17:00'. null when the source gives none.

affects_classes.description: Do classes meet? 'unstated' is a first-class value -- it triggers a known-unknown response and an escalation offer rather than an inference.

student_action_required.description: True when a student must DO something by this date. Drives answer prioritization and Phase 4 nudges.

action_summary.description: One line: what the student must do.

aliases.description: Student phrasings for this event: 'first day of school', 'when does the dorm open'. Feeds tool-side keyword matching.

references.description: ids of other records that qualify this one (e.g. the refund schedule for a withdrawal deadline).

data_quality_flags.description: Surfaces into the data-quality report for the owning office. Non-empty means passed-with-warnings at best.
